D131　重启请求与接收端去重

第 19 周 · 2 小时。前置阅读为 D130-改派工单的原子检查点。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

把服务重启交给独立接收进程。后端持久化投递并记为 dispatching；接收器只管理指定租户、班组下登记的本地 diagnosis-preview 教学服务，确认新进程就绪后回写其 PID。 接入真实接收端后，重启动作还需 service:restart-preview 专项权限；原有设备管理、租户范围及独立复核检查一并保留。

零、闭卷回忆

D130　改派的检查点为什么与工单同事务？

核对答案

避免改派成功但任务仍可重复执行。

D128　取消能在哪些状态成功？

核对答案

waiting 或 ready 且没过期。

D124　上周如何防止两个请求都消费同一批准？

核对答案

用数据库条件更新消费一次，业务效果和消费同事务提交。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 投递、认领、确认是三件事

后端用任务编号作为投递唯一键。接收器根据租户、班组、期限和任务状态找工作，在数据库事务里重查两人的权限、参数摘要与工单版本，再把 startedAt 从空改为当前时间。新的工作进程启动并监听端口后才确认 PID。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/durable-preview.e2e-spec.ts -t "重复恢复只有一份投递并可重放同一接收回执"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/durable-preview.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('重复恢复只有一份投递并可重放同一接收回执', async () => {
    const { row, path, resume } = await dispatch();
    await resume();
    expect(await f.db.previewDelivery.count({ where: { taskId: row.id } })).toBe(1);
    await f.api.post(path + '/cancel').set('authorization', f.auth).expect(409);
    expect(await takePreview(f.db, row.tenantKey, row.groupId)).toBe(row.id);
    expect(await takePreview(f.db, row.tenantKey, row.groupId)).toBeNull();
    await confirmPreview(f.db, row.id, 12345); await confirmPreview(f.db, row.id, 12345);
    expect((await resume()).body.data.receipt).toEqual({ action: 'restart', generation: row.id, pid: 12345 });
  });

推导题　后端恢复时看见 dispatching，为什么只查回执？

答案

此时投递早已和检查点一起提交。重新发起物理动作可能打断刚启动的服务。应通过相同任务编号读取接收方保存的结果。

1.2 超时后的不确定状态需要对账

如果到投递截止时还没有 PID，接收方连认领都没发生就记 not_started；已认领但缺回执则记 unknown。两者都结束自动推进，保留任务号给值班人员对账。 人工审批窗口是 24 小时；投递等待取“原审批到期”和“派发后 60 秒”中较早的时刻。重启后重新读绝对时间，不会获得新的 60 秒。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/durable-preview.e2e-spec.ts -t "超时区分尚未启动与结果不明"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/durable-preview.e2e-spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('超时区分尚未启动与结果不明', async () => {
    for (const claimed of [false,true]) {
      const { row, resume } = await dispatch();
      if (claimed) expect(await takePreview(f.db, row.tenantKey, row.groupId)).toBe(row.id);
      const delivery = await f.db.previewDelivery.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { taskId: row.id } });
      vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] });
      try {
        vi.setSystemTime(delivery.deadline);
        const result = (await resume()).body.data;
        expect(result.state).toBe('blocked');
        expect(result.receipt.outcome).toBe(claimed ? 'unknown' : 'not_started');
      } finally { vi.useRealTimers(); }
    }
  });

推导题　接收进程刚换好服务就损坏，系统能凭超时断定重启失败吗？

答案

不能。外部动作与业务数据库没有共同事务。保留认领记录和 unknown，按目标服务代次、PID 与运行日志核实；不能用超时自动触发另一次重启。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　做出可重放的投递

提示一 · 方向

提示三 · 实现顺序

步骤 2　用本地服务验证代次

提示三 · 实现顺序

接收器只管理自己派生的回环预览进程，新服务的 /health 返回 generation 和 pid。D132 用自动化夹具完成配置和清理。 单独从终端启动会打印本机端口、进程号与代次，可访问该回环端口的 /health 进行核实。

三、自检与提交

运行协议用例后指出哪些证据证明“已投递”“已开始”“已就绪”。分别记录尚未认领和已认领后超时的回执。 再验证投递后、接收器认领前撤销审批人角色，确认 startedAt 为空，业务回执说明权限或资源条件已改变。

import 'dotenv/config';
import { fork, type ChildProcess } from 'node:child_process';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { setTimeout as sleep } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { Client } from 'pg';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { confirmPreview, takePreview } from './preview-receiver.js';

const ready = z.object({ port: z.number().int().positive(), pid: z.number().int().positive(), generation: z.string() });
function announce(info: z.infer<typeof ready>) {
  if (process.send) process.send(info);
  else console.info(JSON.stringify({ service: 'diagnosis-preview', ...info }));
}
async function boot(generation: string) {
  const child = fork(resolve('../../scripts/preview-service.mjs'), [generation], { execArgv: [], windowsHide: true,
    env: { SystemRoot: process.env.SystemRoot }, stdio: ['ignore','ignore','ignore','ipc'] });
  try {
    const [message] = await once(child, 'message', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
    const info = ready.parse(message);
    if (info.pid !== child.pid || info.generation !== generation) throw new Error('PREVIEW_BOOT_MISMATCH');
    return { child, info };
  } catch (error) { child.kill(); throw error; }
}
async function stop(child: ChildProcess) {
  if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) return;
  const exited = once(child, 'exit', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
  if (child.connected) child.disconnect(); else child.kill();
  try { await exited; } catch { child.kill(); throw new Error('PREVIEW_STOP_TIMEOUT'); }
}
async function main() {
  const tenant = z.string().min(1).parse(process.env.PREVIEW_TENANT);
  const group = z.uuid().parse(process.env.PREVIEW_GROUP);
  const lock = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
  const db = new PrismaService();
  let running = true, active: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof boot>> | undefined;
  const shutdown = () => { running = false; };
  process.once('SIGTERM', shutdown); process.once('SIGINT', shutdown); process.once('disconnect', shutdown);
  lock.on('error', shutdown);
  await lock.connect();
  try {
    const result = await lock.query<{ held: boolean }>('SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock(hashtextextended($1,0)) AS held',
      [JSON.stringify(['preview-host', tenant, group])]);
    if (!result.rows[0].held) throw new Error('PREVIEW_HOST_ALREADY_ACTIVE');
    active = await boot('initial');
    announce(active.info);
    while (running) {
      const taskId = await takePreview(db, tenant, group);
      if (taskId) {
        await stop(active.child);
        active = await boot(taskId);
        await confirmPreview(db, taskId, active.info.pid);
        announce(active.info);
      } else await sleep(100);
    }
  } finally {
    if (active) await stop(active.child);
    await db.$disconnect(); await lock.end();
  }
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  main().catch(() => { console.error('预览服务接收端已停止，请核对投递记录'); process.exitCode = 1; });
}

import { HttpException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { authorizeOperation } from './durable-executor.service.js';

// 接收端和业务后端可以分别重启。首次认领落库后，投递不会自动再次触发物理重启。
export async function takePreview(db: PrismaService, tenantKey: string, groupId: string) {
  return db.serializable(async tx => {
    const item = await tx.previewDelivery.findFirst({ where: { tenantKey, groupId, task: { state: 'dispatching' }, startedAt: null, failure: null,
      deadline: { gt: new Date() } }, orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { taskId: 'asc' }] });
    if (!item) return null;
    const task = await tx.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: item.taskId } });
    try { await authorizeOperation(tx, task, 'dispatching'); }
    catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof HttpException)) throw error;
      await tx.previewDelivery.update({ where: { taskId: task.id }, data: { failure: 'permission_or_version_changed' } });
      return null;
    }
    const accepted = await tx.previewDelivery.updateMany({ where: { taskId: task.id, startedAt: null, deadline: { gt: new Date() } },
      data: { startedAt: new Date() } });
    return accepted.count === 1 ? task.id : null;
  });
}
export async function confirmPreview(db: PrismaService, taskId: string, pid: number) {
  const result = await db.previewDelivery.updateMany({ where: { taskId, startedAt: { not: null }, bootPid: null, failure: null },
    data: { bootPid: pid } });
  if (!result.count) {
    const old = await db.previewDelivery.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { taskId } });
    if (old.bootPid !== pid) throw new Error('PREVIEW_RECEIPT_CONFLICT');
  }
}

describe('重启投递与接收回执', () => {
  let f: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof durableFixtures>>;
  beforeAll(async () => { f = await durableFixtures('DPV'); });
  afterAll(async () => { await f.close(); });
  async function dispatch() {
    const flow = await f.prepare('restart');
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    const path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + row.id;
    await f.api.post(path + '/review').set('authorization', f.reviewAuth).send({ decision: 'approve', digest: row.digest }).expect(201);
    const resume = () => f.api.post(path + '/resume').set('authorization', f.auth).send({}).expect(201);
    expect((await resume()).body.data.state).toBe('dispatching');
    return { row, path, resume };
  }
  it('重复恢复只有一份投递并可重放同一接收回执', async () => {
    const { row, path, resume } = await dispatch();
    await resume();
    expect(await f.db.previewDelivery.count({ where: { taskId: row.id } })).toBe(1);
    await f.api.post(path + '/cancel').set('authorization', f.auth).expect(409);
    expect(await takePreview(f.db, row.tenantKey, row.groupId)).toBe(row.id);
    expect(await takePreview(f.db, row.tenantKey, row.groupId)).toBeNull();
    await confirmPreview(f.db, row.id, 12345); await confirmPreview(f.db, row.id, 12345);
    expect((await resume()).body.data.receipt).toEqual({ action: 'restart', generation: row.id, pid: 12345 });
  });
  it('超时区分尚未启动与结果不明', async () => {
    for (const claimed of [false,true]) {
      const { row, resume } = await dispatch();
      if (claimed) expect(await takePreview(f.db, row.tenantKey, row.groupId)).toBe(row.id);
      const delivery = await f.db.previewDelivery.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { taskId: row.id } });
      vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] });
      try {
        vi.setSystemTime(delivery.deadline);
        const result = (await resume()).body.data;
        expect(result.state).toBe('blocked');
        expect(result.receipt.outcome).toBe(claimed ? 'unknown' : 'not_started');
      } finally { vi.useRealTimers(); }
    }
  });
  it('接收端认领之前复核指定审批人的权限', async () => {
    const flow = await f.prepare('restart');
    const role = await f.db.role.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'leader' } });
    const reviewer = await f.db.user.create({ data: { username: 'review-' + randomUUID(), displayName: '临时复核员',
      groupId: flow.ticket.groupId, roles: { create: { roleId: role.id } } } });
    try {
      const row = (await f.api.post(flow.path).set('authorization', f.auth).send({ ...flow.body, reviewerId: reviewer.id }).expect(201)).body.data;
      const path = '/api/agent/tasks/' + row.id, login = await tokenIssuer(f.app);
      await f.api.post(path + '/review').set('authorization', login(reviewer.username)).send({ decision: 'approve', digest: row.digest }).expect(201);
      const resume = () => f.api.post(path + '/resume').set('authorization', f.auth).send({}).expect(201);
      expect((await resume()).body.data.state).toBe('dispatching');
      await f.db.userRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: reviewer.id } });
      expect(await takePreview(f.db, row.tenantKey, row.groupId)).toBeNull();
      expect((await resume()).body.data.receipt.outcome).toBe('permission_or_version_changed');
      expect((await f.db.previewDelivery.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { taskId: row.id } })).startedAt).toBeNull();
    } finally {
      await f.db.userRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: reviewer.id } });
      await f.db.user.update({ where: { id: reviewer.id }, data: { groupId: null } });
    }
  });
});

import { createServer } from 'node:http';

// 只在本机提供代次和进程号，便于外部探针核对新进程是否就绪。
const generation = process.argv[2];
const app = createServer((req, res) => {
  if (req.url !== '/health') { res.writeHead(404).end(); return; }
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }).end(JSON.stringify({ generation, pid: process.pid }));
});
app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => process.send?.({ port: app.address().port, pid: process.pid, generation }));
process.on('disconnect', () => app.close());

import { ConflictException, ForbiddenException, HttpException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { DurableTask } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketsService } from '../tickets/tickets.service.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { commandDigest, commandSchema, stillValid } from './durable-command.js';
import { participant } from './durable-tasks.service.js';

export async function authorizeOperation(tx: TransactionClient, row: DurableTask, state: 'ready' | 'dispatching' = 'ready') {
  const cmd = commandSchema.parse(row.command);
  const digest = commandDigest(row.runId, row.ticketNo, row.ownerId, row.tenantKey, cmd);
  if (row.state !== state || !stillValid(row.expiresAt) || row.approvedDigest !== digest || row.digest !== digest) throw new ConflictException('缺少有效批准');
  const { ticket, user } = await participant(tx, row.ownerId, row.tenantKey, row.ticketNo, cmd);
  await participant(tx, row.reviewerId, row.tenantKey, row.ticketNo, cmd, true);
  if (ticket.version !== cmd.version || ticket.groupId !== row.groupId) throw new ConflictException('批准时的工单已变化');
  return user;
}

@Injectable()
export class DurableExecutor {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly tickets: TicketsService, private readonly audit: AuditService) {}


  async advance(id: string) {
    const row = await this.db.durableTask.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (row.state === 'completed') return row;
    if (row.state === 'dispatching') return this.collect(row);
    if (row.state !== 'ready') throw new ConflictException('任务尚未就绪');
    const cmd = commandSchema.parse(row.command);
    const owner = await this.db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.ownerId }, select: { username: true } });
    try {
      if (cmd.action === 'restart') {
        await this.db.serializable(async tx => {
          const current = await tx.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
          if (current.state === 'dispatching' || current.state === 'completed') return;
          const user = await authorizeOperation(tx, current);
          const deadline = new Date(Math.min(row.expiresAt.getTime(), Date.now() + 60_000));
          await tx.previewDelivery.create({ data: { taskId: id, tenantKey: row.tenantKey, groupId: row.groupId, deadline } });
          await tx.durableTask.update({ where: { id }, data: { state: 'dispatching' } });
          await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: row.ownerId, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'durable.dispatched',
            entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { taskId: id, digest: row.digest } });
        });
        return this.collect(row);
      }
      await this.tickets.reassign(row.ticketNo, { assignee: cmd.assignee, version: cmd.version, reason: cmd.reason },
        owner.username, {}, async (tx, actorId, targetId) => {
          if (actorId !== row.ownerId || targetId !== row.assigneeId) throw new ForbiddenException();
          const current = await tx.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
          const user = await authorizeOperation(tx, current);
          const target = await tx.user.findFirst({ where: { id: targetId, tenantKey: row.tenantKey, groupId: row.groupId, username: cmd.assignee } });
          if (!target) throw new ForbiddenException();
          const receipt = { action: cmd.action, ticketNo: row.ticketNo, version: cmd.version + 1, assigneeId: targetId };
          const changed = await tx.durableTask.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'ready', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
            data: { state: 'completed', receipt } });
          if (!changed.count) throw new ConflictException();
          await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'durable.completed',
            entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { taskId: id, digest: row.digest, ...receipt } });
          return agentScope(user);
        });
    } catch (error) {
      const saved = await this.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
      if (saved.state === 'completed') return saved;
      if (error instanceof HttpException && [403,404,409].includes(error.getStatus())) {
        const state = stillValid(row.expiresAt) ? 'blocked' : 'expired';
        const failureCode = state === 'expired' ? 'APPROVAL_EXPIRED' : error.getStatus() === 403 ? 'ACCESS_CHANGED' :
          error.getStatus() === 404 ? 'TARGET_UNAVAILABLE' : 'STATE_CHANGED';
        await this.db.serializable(async tx => {
          const changed = await tx.durableTask.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'ready' }, data: { state, failureCode } });
          if (changed.count) await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: row.ownerId, actorUsername: owner.username, action: 'durable.' + state,
            entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { taskId: id, failureCode } });
        });
      }
      throw error;
    }
    return this.db.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
  }
  private collect(row: DurableTask) {
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const current = await tx.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } });
      if (current.state !== 'dispatching') return current;
      const delivery = await tx.previewDelivery.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { taskId: row.id } });
      if (!delivery.bootPid && !delivery.failure && stillValid(delivery.deadline)) return current;
      // 没收到回执时区分从未认领与结果不明；两者都不会再发第二次重启。
      const receipt = delivery.bootPid ? { action: 'restart', generation: row.id, pid: delivery.bootPid } :
        { action: 'restart', outcome: delivery.failure ?? (delivery.startedAt ? 'unknown' : 'not_started') };
      const state = delivery.bootPid ? 'completed' : 'blocked';
      const owner = await tx.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.ownerId }, select: { username: true } });
      await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: row.ownerId, actorUsername: owner.username, action: 'durable.' + state,
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { taskId: row.id, ...receipt } });
      return tx.durableTask.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { state, receipt, failureCode: state === 'blocked' ? 'PREVIEW_CONFIRMATION_MISSING' : null } });
    });
  }

}

import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { readAccess } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import type { DurableTask } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { approvalWindowMs, commandDigest, commandSchema, stillValid, type DurableCommand } from './durable-command.js';

const inputSchema = z.object({ requestKey: z.uuid(), reviewerId: z.uuid(), command: commandSchema }).strict();
export async function participant(tx: TransactionClient, id: string, tenant: string, ticketNo: string, command: DurableCommand, reviewer = false) {
  const { user } = await readAccess(tx, id).catch((error: unknown) => {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN') throw new ForbiddenException();
    throw error;
  });
  if (user.tenantKey !== tenant) throw new NotFoundException();
  const needed = command.action === 'reassign' ? 'ticket:assign' : 'device:manage';
  if (command.action === 'restart' && !user.permissions?.includes('service:restart-preview')) throw new ForbiddenException();
  if (!user.permissions?.includes(needed) || (reviewer && !user.permissions.includes('agent:review-operation'))) throw new ForbiddenException();
  const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { ...agentScope(user), ticketNo },
    select: { id: true, groupId: true, version: true, status: true } });
  if (!ticket) throw new NotFoundException();
  return { user, ticket };
}
export function effectiveState(task: DurableTask) {
  return ['waiting','ready'].includes(task.state) && !stillValid(task.expiresAt) ? 'expired' : task.state;
}
@Injectable()
export class DurableTasksService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly audit: AuditService) {}

  async submit(ownerId: string, runId: string, input: unknown) {
    const parsed = inputSchema.safeParse(input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new BadRequestException('持久任务格式无效');
    const { command, reviewerId, requestKey } = parsed.data;
    if (ownerId === reviewerId) throw new ForbiddenException('请选择另一位复核人');
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const run = await tx.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id: runId, userId: ownerId } });
      if (!run) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { ticket, user } = await participant(tx, ownerId, run.tenantKey, run.ticketNo, command);
      const digest = commandDigest(runId, run.ticketNo, ownerId, run.tenantKey, command);
      const key = { runId_requestKey: { runId, requestKey } };
      const existing = await tx.durableTask.findUnique({ where: key });
      if (existing) {
        if (existing.digest !== digest || existing.reviewerId !== reviewerId) throw new ConflictException('请求键对应另一份意图');
        return { ...existing, state: effectiveState(existing) };
      }
      await participant(tx, reviewerId, run.tenantKey, run.ticketNo, command, true);
      if (ticket.version !== command.version) throw new ConflictException('工单版本已改变');
      const assignee = command.action === 'reassign' ? await tx.user.findFirst({
        where: { username: command.assignee, tenantKey: run.tenantKey, groupId: ticket.groupId }, select: { id: true },
      }) : null;
      if (command.action === 'reassign' && (!assignee || ticket.status !== 'processing')) throw new ConflictException('改派目标或工单状态无效');
      const created = await tx.durableTask.createMany({ skipDuplicates: true, data: {
        runId, requestKey, ownerId, reviewerId, tenantKey: run.tenantKey, ticketNo: run.ticketNo,
        groupId: ticket.groupId, assigneeId: assignee?.id, command, digest, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + approvalWindowMs),
      } });
      const row = await tx.durableTask.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: key });
      if (row.digest !== digest || row.reviewerId !== reviewerId) throw new ConflictException();
      if (created.count) await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: ownerId, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'durable.submitted',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { taskId: row.id, digest, reviewerId } });
      return row;
    });
  }

  async get(actor: string, id: string) {
    return this.db.$transaction(async tx => {
      const row = await tx.durableTask.findFirst({ where: { id, OR: [{ ownerId: actor }, { reviewerId: actor }] } });
      if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { ticket } = await participant(tx, actor, row.tenantKey, row.ticketNo, commandSchema.parse(row.command), actor === row.reviewerId);
      if (ticket.groupId !== row.groupId) throw new NotFoundException();
      return { ...row, state: effectiveState(row) };
    });
  }

  async review(actor: string, id: string, input: unknown) {
    const parsed = z.object({ decision: z.enum(['approve','reject']), digest: z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/) }).strict().safeParse(input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new BadRequestException('只接受决定和已展示的摘要');
    const { decision, digest } = parsed.data;
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const row = await tx.durableTask.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
      if (row.reviewerId !== actor || row.ownerId === actor) throw new ForbiddenException('仅指定的独立复核人能决定');
      const cmd = commandSchema.parse(row.command);
      const { ticket, user } = await participant(tx, actor, row.tenantKey, row.ticketNo, cmd, true);
      if (row.digest !== digest || row.digest !== commandDigest(row.runId, row.ticketNo, row.ownerId, row.tenantKey, cmd)) {
        throw new ConflictException('所见参数与保存的意图不同');
      }
      if (ticket.groupId !== row.groupId) throw new NotFoundException();
      if (decision === 'approve') {
        await participant(tx, row.ownerId, row.tenantKey, row.ticketNo, cmd);
        if (ticket.version !== cmd.version) throw new ConflictException('工单版本已改变');
      }
      const state = decision === 'approve' ? 'ready' : 'rejected';
      const change = await tx.durableTask.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'waiting', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
        data: { state, approvedDigest: decision === 'approve' ? digest : null } });
      if (!change.count) throw new ConflictException('申请已决定、取消或过期');
      await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'durable.' + state,
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { taskId: id, digest } });
      return { id, state };
    });
  }

  async cancel(actor: string, id: string) {
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const row = await tx.durableTask.findFirst({ where: { id, ownerId: actor } });
      if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
      // 所有者即使失去操作权限也可撤销。仅返回编号和状态。
      if (row.state === 'cancelled') return { id, state: row.state };
      const changed = await tx.durableTask.updateMany({ where: { id, state: { in: ['waiting','ready'] }, expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
        data: { state: 'cancelled' } });
      if (!changed.count) throw new ConflictException('任务已过期或越过取消点');
      const user = await tx.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: actor }, select: { username: true } });
      await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'durable.cancelled',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { taskId: id } });
      return { id, state: 'cancelled' };
    });
  }
}
